blocks.text: Yeh oonchai par 'thande registan' ya ghaas ke maidan hain jahan aab-o-hawa bare darakhton ke liye bohat sakht hai.

blocks.caption: alpine aur sub-alpine charagahein ka khaaka
rows: Gilgit-Baltistan, Chitral, Swat, Azad Jammu aur Kashmir ki pahari chotiyan aur Deosai ke maidan
sakht sardi; salana ausat 1 se 10 C
zyada tar bhaari barf, 6 feet tak
thingne juniper, bhoj (Betula utilis), bed, alpine ghaas aur jangli phool
barfani cheeta, Himalayan bhoora reechh, Himalayan ibex, musk deer, marmot; snowcock, monal, golden eagle
nazuk: global warming se bohat mutasir, pighalti barf charagah ka tawazun bigarti

blocks.alt: Barfeeli chotiyon ke neeche oonchi charagah; chhote conifer sirf door neechi dhalwanon par. Labels: bari chattan par snow leopard, bil ke paas marmots, pathreeli dhalwan par Himalayan ibex, charta hua Himalayan brown bear, neechi thingni (stunted) junipers aur bohat se jangli phool.
blocks.caption: Figure 25.13: Alpine charagah aur us ke numainda paude aur janwar (kitab ki tasveer, Figure 25.13, ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.prompt: alpine aur sub-alpine charagahein ka aik paudha aur aik janwar batayein.
blocks.explanation: Maslan thingne juniper aur barfani cheeta.
